title: Bladee Music Compilation
description: A Minecraft datapack adding 75+ custom music discs featuring albums and tracks from Bladee
body:
Transform your Minecraft world into an atmospheric music archive inspired by the universe of **Bladee** and the Drain Gang collective.

This datapack adds over 75 playable songs through custom music discs featuring albums such as:

- Sulfur Surfer
- Gluee
- Icedancer
- Working on Dying

It also includes many singles, collaborations, and rare tracks.

Features:
- multiplayer support
- fully compatible with vanilla jukeboxes
- custom textures and item names
- high-quality audio
- survival-friendly integration.

INCLUDES A RESOURCE PACK THAT MUST BE ENABLED SIMULTANEOUSLY TO THE DATAPACK

**HOW TO COLLETS THE DISCS**

**Discs will generate** inside of chests in:
- dungeons
- mineshafts
- desert pyramids
- igloos
- jungle temples
- ruined portals (occasionally)
- strongholds (except libraries)
- woodland mansions
  
- You can also get them by **fishing** (they are in the junk loot category) and when a **skeleton kills a creeper**... Good luck finding them all!

Will probably update this with more songs.


**MUST have the resource pack enabled for the datapack to work properly.**
